latin: Sex uiis futura homini deus denuntiat: per Somnia, Portenta, Aues, Intestina, Spiritum, et Sibyllam.
translation: God discloses to man what is to come along six paths: by dreams, by portents, by the flight of birds, by entrails, by possession of spirit, and by the Sibyl.
